claims.content: Coordinate transmit filters with all IUs by identifying filters by filter number to minimize track management problems.

goal.raw_text: Coordinate transmit filters with all IUs by identifying filters by filter number to minimize track management problems.

claims.content: C2 JU
The use of interface filters shall be coordinated with all IUs to minimize track management problems.
Filters are identified by filter number for coordination with other JUs.
If the C2 JU filters tracks/IUs on receipt, a transmit filter that duplicates the receive filter must be established.
For filtering of C2 IUs, the C2 IUs have the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message; active nonsimulated C2 IUs cannot be filtered.
A C2 JU requests or reports the insertion or deletion of transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, to coordinate with all IUs and minimize track management problems.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU requests or reports the insertion or deletion of transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, to coordinate with all IUs and minimize track management problems.

claims.content: The C2 JU requests or reports the insertion or deletion of transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, in J7.6 messages.
The C2 JU uses the Filter Unit Type field to indicate whether the filter applies to individual JU transmissions or forwarding unit transmissions of forwarded data.

For forwarding unit filters, the C2 JU requests or reports only those filters used for filtering transmissions originating on Link 16; filters for forwarding data from any other link to Link 16 are neither requested nor reported via Link 16.
The C2 JU identifies all filters by filter number for coordination with other JUs.
The C2 JU coordinates the use of interface filters with all IUs to minimize track management problems, using voice or other communications media.
The C2 JU requests or reports track filters in separate J7.6 messages from reference point and EW product filters.
When a transmit filter is activated, the C2 JU ceases reporting any track for which it has R2 and which meets the filter criteria.
The C2 JU applies filters to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as to tracks initiated while the filter is active.
The C2 JU ensures tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface only if they are not inhibited from transmission by any of the transmission filters currently set.
The C2 JU does not request or report the use of receive filters via Link 16.
The C2 JU may filter C2 IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message; active nonsimulated C2 IUs cannot be filtered.
The C2 JU does not filter any track or nonC2 IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1.
At main flow step 0, if the transmit filter is a special processing filter, a JU filters data based on the setting of the Special Processing Indicator field.
At main flow step 0, if the transmit filter is a simulation filter, a JU filters data and IUs based on the setting of the Simulation Indicator field.

At main flow step 0, if the transmit filter is an environment/category filter, a JU filters tracks and nonC2 IUs from the space, air, surface (maritime), subsurface (maritime), and land (ground) environment/categories, as well as reference points and electronic warfare product information.

At main flow step 0, if the transmit filter is an ID filter, a JU filters tracks and nonC2 IUs based on their IDs; Exercise Indicator settings have no influence on ID filters, and Identity and Identity Amplifying Descriptor are filtered in the same manner.

At main flow step 0, if the transmit filter is a geographic filter, a JU filters tracks and nonC2 IUs based on their geographic location; maximum and minimum altitude values may also be defined for each filter to describe volumes; filters can be fixed geographically, slaved to the filtering JU or some other moving reference point, or move independently.

At main flow step 0, if the filter is a message label/sublabel filter, the J7.6 message shall not be used to request implementation/deletion or status of message label/sublabel filters, and this type of filter will not be reported in the J7.6 Filter Description Report; if implemented, the message label/sublabel filter shall only be used for the purposes described and shall not be used as a data filter.

At main flow step 0, filters requested or reported in J7.6 do not apply to any messages other than the J2, J3, and J12 (on Needline PG) series messages listed, except a simulation filter applies to C2 IUs.

At main flow step 5, an exception to requesting/reporting track filters in separate J7.6 messages from reference point and EW product filters applies if in a track filter message the Unknown E/C Filter Indicator is set to value 1.
At main flow step 6, if a track or nonC2 IU has an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1, it shall not be filtered.

At main flow step 9, if a system filters tracks/IUs on receipt, it must establish a transmit filter which duplicates the receive filter; when a receive filter is geographically defined, the transmit filter must, where possible, be defined to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations.
At main flow step 10, if a C2 IU is active nonsimulated, it cannot be filtered.
If the filter is a receive filter, the use of receive filters is neither requested nor reported via Link 16; exit by not requesting or reporting receive filters via Link 16.

If forwarding unit filters are for forwarding data from any other link to Link 16, they are neither requested nor reported via Link 16; exit by not requesting or reporting such forwarding unit filters via Link 16.

If filters requested or reported in the J7.6 messages are for messages other than the J2, J3, and J12 (on Needline PG) series messages listed, they do not apply, except a simulation filter applies to C2 IUs; exit by not applying those filters to other messages.
If any track or nonC2 IU has an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1, it shall not be filtered; exit by not filtering that track or nonC2 IU.
If a C2 IU is active nonsimulated, it cannot be filtered; exit by not filtering active nonsimulated C2 IUs. C2 IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.

If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority; this procedure applies to both real-time and nonrealtime data. Exit by not requiring acceptance of the new data.

If a C2 JU is deactivating a receive filter, after initially achieving Active status or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, it shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed; the minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds. Exit by delaying track transmission until the minimum wait is satisfied.
The use of interface filters has been coordinated with all IUs to minimize track management problems.
All filters are identified by filter number for coordination with other JUs.
For any system that filters tracks/IUs on receipt, a transmit filter duplicating the receive filter has been established.

When a receive filter is geographically defined, the transmit filter is defined, where possible, to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations.
Tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface only if they are not inhibited from transmission by any of the transmission filters currently set.
Filters apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as to tracks initiated while the filter is active.
When a transmit filter is activated by a unit, the unit has ceased reporting any track for which it has R2 and which meets the filter criteria.
Active nonsimulated C2 IUs are not filtered; C2 IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.
No track or nonC2 IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 is filtered.
